_comment: Shipped sampling templates for model names. Updated by releases: do not edit here — put your overrides under model_sampling.templates in config/claude-hooks.json, which install never overwrites. Pattern (glob on the model name) -> Ollama options. Measured values only; see claude_hooks/model_sampling.py.

glm-5.3*._why: Cerebriline prompt-template work, 2026-09: 0.2 broke, the cloud default 1.0 answered poorly, 0.7 worked well. Bench 2026-09-23/24: as judge, repeat agreement 67->78 %; as coder unchanged (Q 0.770 vs 0.767). Repetition penalties measured and rejected (coder Q 0.740).

deepseek-v4.1-flash*._why: Bench 2026-09-24 (docs/benchmarks/judge-and-sampling.md): as coder identical to the cloud default (Q 0.827, 60/60 both); as judge repeat agreement 65->73 %, AUC 0.882->0.891, cheaper and faster (1.8->1.2 s/verdict).
